newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips $1, barges trade at $186.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips $1, barges trade at $186.

text.p: NWE gasoline eased $1 a tonne on Wednesday morning, tracking weaker overnight levels on NYMEX and softer crude oil.
Rotterdam barges traded at $186 fob for premium unleaded and at $178.50 for regular but swaps were geenrally quiet.
July was pegged around $186.25, while August was reported to have traded at $185.75 and September talked $184.00.

"It was a pretty slow morning. Nigeria is obviously going to prop up the Med but in the north there's very little demand," said a trader. Dealers were keenly awaiting stock figures for Europe due to be published by Euroilstock at 1300 GMT.
